faqs.a: App developers, agencies, freelancers, theme builders and other businesses that work with Shopify merchants.

faqs.q: Does it cost anything to join?
faqs.a: There is no cost to apply. We share the program details when we review your application.
Approved partners get a card in the directory with their logo, type, a short description and a link to their site.

faqs.q: How do I update my listing?
faqs.a: Send us your changes with the form on this page and we'll update your card.
